originalText: Many people type at once · local-first edits, live cursors, works offline

text:
Key decisions (RADIO)
- Edits apply locally first (zero lag),
  then sync as CRDT updates
- CRDT (Yjs) vs OT: CRDT merges offline
  and peer edits without a central lock
- Presence is separate, lossy, throttled
- Comments anchor to relative positions
- Heavy work in a Web Worker
